failure_modes.name: Solver_Passage_Content_Misreading
failure_modes.evidence: In hop 2, the solver states 'the passages contain no information establishing that Dan Hurley is the brother of Robert Matthew Hurley, nor do they identify Robert Matthew Hurley as the head coach of Arizona State's men's basketball team' when this information was clearly present in hop 1 passage [1]: 'Robert Matthew Hurley... Hurley is currently the head coach of the Arizona State men's team... on the staffs of his younger brother Dan.'

failure_modes.name: Multi_Hop_Context_Degradation
failure_modes.evidence: The solver lost track of information from hop 1: after correctly identifying in summary_1 that 'Dan Hurley is the younger brother of Robert Matthew Hurley (passage [1])' and 'Robert Matthew Hurley is the head coach of Arizona State's men's basketball team (passage [1])', in summary_2 the solver claims 'the passages contain no information establishing that Dan Hurley is the brother of Robert Matthew Hurley, nor do they identify Robert Matthew Hurley as the head coach of Arizona State's men's basketball team.'

failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query 'Who was the first year head coach of the 2012–13 Rhode Island Rams men's basketball team, and what is his relationship to the Arizona State men's basketball head coach?' re-asks the same questions already answered in hop 1, failing to advance the investigation. Hop 3 query 'Are Dan Hurley and Robert Matthew Hurley brothers, and is Robert Matthew Hurley the head coach of Arizona State's men's basketball team?' also re-asks already-answered questions.
